quark-drive.shortEffect: Raises highest stat on Electric Terrain, or if holding Booster Energy.
quark-drive.effect: Boosts the Pokémon’s most proficient stat on Electric Terrain or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.
quark-drive.flavor: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat on Electric Terrain or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

horn-attack.name: Horn Attack
horn-attack.shortEffect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

defense-curl.name: Defense Curl
defense-curl.shortEffect: Raises user’s Defense by one stage.
defense-curl.effect: Raises user’s Defense by one stage. After this move is used, the power of Ice Ball and Rollout are doubled until the user leaves the field.

rollout.name: Rollout
rollout.shortEffect: Power doubles every turn this move is used in succession after the first, resetting after five turns.
rollout.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to use this move for five turns. Power doubles every time this move is used in succession to a maximum of 16x, and resets to normal after the lock-in ends. If this move misses or becomes unusable, the lock-in ends. If the user has used Defense Curl since entering the field, this move has double power.

electric-terrain.name: Electric Terrain
electric-terrain.shortEffect: For five turns, prevents all Pokémon on the ground from sleeping and strengthens their Electric moves to 1.5× their power.
electric-terrain.effect: For five turns, prevents all Pokémon on the ground from sleeping and strengthens their Electric moves to 1.5× their power. Changes Nature Power to Thunderbolt.

bulldoze.name: Bulldoze
bulldoze.shortEffect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
bulldoze.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

rapid-spin.name: Rapid Spin
rapid-spin.shortEffect: Frees the user from binding moves, removes Leech Seed, and blows away Spikes.
rapid-spin.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Removes Leech Seed from the user, frees the user from Bind, Clamp, Fire Spin, Magma Storm, Sand Tomb, Whirlpool, and Wrap, and clears Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Toxic Spikes from the user’s side of the field. If this move misses or has no effect, its effect doesn’t activate.

iron-head.name: Iron Head
iron-head.shortEffect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
iron-head.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

stomping-tantrum.name: Stomping Tantrum
stomping-tantrum.shortEffect: Has double power if the user’s last move failed.
stomping-tantrum.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Power is doubled if the user’s last move failed for any reason (i.e., produced the message "But it failed!") or was ineffective due to types.

knock-off.name: Knock Off
knock-off.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Target loses its held item. Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle. If the target has Multitype or Sticky Hold, it will take damage but not lose its item.

earthquake.name: Earthquake
earthquake.shortEffect: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Dig users.
earthquake.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is in the first turn of Dig, this move will hit with double power.

heavy-slam.name: Heavy Slam
heavy-slam.shortEffect: Power is higher when the user weighs more than the target, up to a maximum of 120.
heavy-slam.effect: Inflicts regular damage. The greater the user’s weight compared to the target’s, the higher power this move has, to a maximum of 120. User’s weight | Power -------------------------------- | ----: Up to 2× the target’s weight | 40 Up to 3× the target’s weight | 60 Up to 4× the target’s weight | 80 Up to 5× the target’s weight | 100 More than 5× the target’s weight | 120

wild-charge.name: Wild Charge
wild-charge.shortEffect: User receives 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.
wild-charge.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

endeavor.name: Endeavor
endeavor.shortEffect: Lowers the target’s HP to equal the user’s.
endeavor.effect: Inflicts exactly enough damage to lower the target’s HP to equal the user’s. If the target’s HP is not higher than the user’s, this move has no effect. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored. This effect counts as damage for moves that respond to damage.

megahorn.name: Megahorn
megahorn.shortEffect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

giga-impact.name: Giga Impact
giga-impact.shortEffect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
giga-impact.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

steel-roller.name: Steel Roller
steel-roller.shortEffect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

body-slam.name: Body Slam
body-slam.shortEffect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
body-slam.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

double-edge.name: Double Edge
double-edge.shortEffect: User receives 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.
double-edge.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

earth-power.name: Earth Power
earth-power.shortEffect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
earth-power.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

electro-ball.name: Electro Ball
electro-ball.shortEffect: Power is higher when the user has greater Speed than the target, up to a maximum of 150.
electro-ball.effect: Inflicts regular damage. The greater the user’s Speed compared to the target’s, the higher power this move has, to a maximum of 150. User’s Speed | Power -------------------------------- | ----: Up to 2× the target’s Speed | 60 Up to 3× the target’s Speed | 80 Up to 4× the target’s Speed | 120 More than 4× the target’s Speed | 150

facade.name: Facade
facade.shortEffect: Power doubles if user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned.
facade.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, this move has double power.

flash-cannon.name: Flash Cannon
flash-cannon.shortEffect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
flash-cannon.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

gyro-ball.name: Gyro Ball
gyro-ball.shortEffect: Power raises when the user has lower Speed, up to a maximum of 150.
gyro-ball.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the target’s current Speed compared to the user, given by `1 + 25 * target Speed / user Speed`, capped at 150.

high-horsepower.name: High Horsepower
high-horsepower.shortEffect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

hyper-beam.name: Hyper Beam
hyper-beam.shortEffect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
hyper-beam.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

ice-fang.name: Ice Fang
ice-fang.shortEffect: Has a chance to freeze the target and a chance to make the target flinch.
ice-fang.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target and a separate chance to make the target flinch.

iron-defense.name: Iron Defense
iron-defense.shortEffect: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.
iron-defense.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.

metal-sound.name: Metal Sound
metal-sound.shortEffect: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.
metal-sound.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.

mud-shot.name: Mud Shot
mud-shot.shortEffect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
mud-shot.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

mud-slap.name: Mud Slap
mud-slap.shortEffect: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.
mud-slap.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

protect.name: Protect
protect.shortEffect: Prevents any moves from hitting the user this turn.
protect.effect: No moves will hit the user for the remainder of this turn. If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail. If the user successfully used Detect, Endure, Protect, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard on the last turn, this move has a 50% chance to fail. Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard provide a (100 – accuracy)% chance for moves to break through this move. This does not apply to one-hit KO moves (Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold); those are always blocked by this move. Thunder during Rain Dance and Blizzard during Hail have a 30% chance to break through this move. The following effects are not prevented by this move: * Acupressure from an ally * Curse’s curse effect * Delayed damage from Doom Desire and Future Sight; however, these moves will be prevented if they are used this turn * Feint, which will also end this move’s protection after it hits * Imprison * Perish Song * Shadow Force * Moves that merely copy the user, such as Transform or Psych Up This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

rest.name: Rest
rest.shortEffect: User sleeps for two turns, completely healing itself.
rest.effect: User falls to sleep and immediately regains all its HP. If the user has another major status effect, sleep will replace it. The user will always wake up after two turns, or one turn with Early Bird. This move fails if the Pokémon cannot fall asleep due to Uproar, Insomnia, or Vital Spirit. It also fails if the Pokémon is at full health or is already asleep.

rock-slide.name: Rock Slide
rock-slide.shortEffect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
rock-slide.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

rock-tomb.name: Rock Tomb
rock-tomb.shortEffect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
rock-tomb.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
sandstorm.shortEffect: Changes the weather to a sandstorm for five turns.
sandstorm.effect: Changes the weather to a sandstorm for five turns. Pokémon that are not Ground, Rock, or Steel take 1/16 their max HP at the end of every turn. Every Rock Pokémon’s original Special Defense is raised by 50% for the duration of this effect. Solar Beam’s power is halved. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis only heal 1/4 the user’s max HP.

scary-face.name: Scary Face
scary-face.shortEffect: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.
scary-face.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.

smart-strike.name: Smart Strike
smart-strike.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

stealth-rock.name: Stealth Rock
stealth-rock.shortEffect: Causes damage when opposing Pokémon switch in.
stealth-rock.effect: Spreads sharp rocks around the opposing field, damaging any Pokémon that enters the field for 1/8 its max HP. This damage is affected by the entering Pokémon’s susceptibility to Rock moves. Rapid Spin removes this effect from its user’s side of the field.

steel-beam.name: Steel Beam
steel-beam.shortEffect: Inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP, rounded up.
steel-beam.effect: Inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP, rounded up. The user still takes damage if the move is blocked by Protect or Substitute, misses, or if the target has Flash Fire.

stone-edge.name: Stone Edge
stone-edge.shortEffect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
stone-edge.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

substitute.name: Substitute
substitute.shortEffect: Transfers 1/4 of the user’s max HP into a doll, protecting the user from further damage or status changes until it breaks.
substitute.effect: Transfers 1/4 the user’s max HP into a doll that absorbs damage and causes most negative move effects to fail. If the user leaves the field, the doll will vanish. If the user cannot pay the HP cost, this move will fail. The doll takes damage as normal, using the user’s stats and types, and will break when its HP reaches zero. Self-inflicted damage from confusion or recoil is not absorbed. Healing effects from opponents ignore the doll and heal the user as normal. Moves that work based on the user’s HP still do so; the doll’s HP does not influence any move. The doll will block major status effects, confusion, and flinching. The effects of Smelling Salts and Wake-Up Slap do not trigger against a doll, even if the Pokémon behind the doll has the appropriate major status effect. Multi-turn trapping moves like Wrap will hit the doll for their regular damage, but the multi-turn trapping and damage effects will not activate. Moves blocked or damage absorbed by the doll do not count as hitting the user or inflicting damage for any effects that respond to such, e.g., Avalanche, Counter, or a Rowap Berry. Magic Coat still works as normal, even against moves the doll would block. Opposing Pokémon that damage the doll with a leech move like Absorb are healed as normal. It will also block Acupressure, Block, the curse effect of Curse, Dream Eater, Embargo, Flatter, Gastro Acid, Grudge, Heal Block, Leech Seed, Lock-On, Mean Look, Mimic, Mind Reader, Nightmare, Pain Split, Psycho Shift, Spider Web, Sketch, Swagger, Switcheroo, Trick, Worry Seed, and Yawn. A Pokémon affected by Yawn before summoning the doll will still fall to sleep. The doll blocks Intimidate, but all other abilities act as though the doll did not exist. If the user has an ability that absorbs moves of a certain type for HP (such as Volt Absorb absorbing Thunder Wave), such moves will not be blocked. Life Orb and berries that cause confusion still work as normal, but their respective HP loss and confusion are absorbed/blocked by the doll. The user is still vulnerable to damage inflicted when entering or leaving the field, such as by Pursuit or Spikes; however, the doll will block the poison effect of Toxic Spikes. The doll is passed on by Baton Pass. It keeps its existing HP, but uses the replacement Pokémon’s stats and types for damage calculation. All other effects work as normal.

take-down.name: Take Down
take-down.shortEffect: User receives 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.
take-down.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

thunder.name: Thunder
thunder.shortEffect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
thunder.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target. During Rain Dance, this move has 100% accuracy. It also has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection of Protect and Detect. During Sunny Day, this move has 50% accuracy.

thunder-fang.name: Thunder Fang
thunder-fang.shortEffect: Has a chance to paralyze the target and a chance to make the target flinch.
thunder-fang.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target and a separate chance to make the target flinch.

volt-switch.name: Volt Switch
volt-switch.shortEffect: User must switch out after attacking.
volt-switch.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then the user immediately switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party. If the target faints from this attack, the user’s trainer selects the new Pokémon to send out first. If the user is the last Pokémon in its party that can battle, it will not switch out. The user may be hit by Pursuit when it switches out, if it has been targeted and Pursuit has not yet been used. This move may be used even if the user is under the effect of Ingrain. Ingrain’s effect will end.

zen-headbutt.name: Zen Headbutt
zen-headbutt.shortEffect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
zen-headbutt.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.
